# Useful-repo-by-anktechsol

> A daily-updated directory of trending and evergreen open-source GitHub repos (AI agents, skills, plugins, MCP servers, automation) with plain-English use cases and setup guides for non-technical users, solo founders, agencies and creators.

- [README](README.md): human overview, trending today, guides and curated lists
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how an AI agent should use this repo
- [data/repos.json](data/repos.json): curated repos with categories
- [data/trending.json](data/trending.json): today's trending AI repos
- [trending/latest.md](trending/latest.md): latest digest
- [guides/](guides/): use cases and how-to per repo
